textbookText: 24. Magnetic orientation of orbitals is also explained by one of the quantum numbers. a. Name the quantum number which explains the orientations of orbitals in space. b. Write down the value of azimuthal(l) and magnetic quantum number (m) for the p subshell and prove that p- orbitals have three different orientations c. Draw the shape of all these three orbitals d. Which of these orbitals have more energy and why?

27. Electronic configuration is used to distribute the electrons in various orbitals of an atom and is based on Aufbau Principle. a. State Aufbau principle. b.
